waiting: Not delivered: {reason}. It will be sent automatically.
held_placeholder: {computer} is offline. Sends when it's back.
banner_awaiting: A message is not confirmed delivered yet: waiting for its receipt ({seconds}s left). It is never sent twice.
banner_awaiting_now: A message got no delivery confirmation in time: it leaves the send queue now, and later messages go on.
banner_behind_one: {count} more message waits behind it and goes in by itself.
banner_behind_other: {count} more messages wait behind it and go in by themselves.
banner_queued_one: {count} message is queued and goes in by itself.
banner_queued_other: {count} messages are queued and go in by themselves.
banner_expired_one: {count} message got no delivery confirmation in time and left the send queue; later messages go on as usual. It may have gone in: check the conversation, then resend or ignore it.
banner_expired_other: {count} messages got no delivery confirmation in time and left the send queue; later messages go on as usual. They may have gone in: check the conversation, then resend or ignore each.
banner_expired_more_one: And {count} more, shown with the messages above.
banner_expired_more_other: And {count} more, shown with the messages above.
